description: A factory class for creating instances of statistics controller classes in the Revive Adserver project, specifically for the OA_Admin_Statistics_Common interface.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Statistics_Factory
classes.description: A factory class to instantiate statistics controller classes based on controller type.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a statistics controller class based on the controller type.

methods.name: _instantiateController
methods.description: Includes the controller file and instantiates the controller class.

methods.name: _getControllerClass
methods.description: Determines the file path and class name for the controller based on the controller type.
